# Question Generation Examples

Below are examples showing how different approaches generate questions from the same source documents. Each example shows:

* The original document content
* Questions generated by the baseline approach
* Questions generated by our Jargonaut approach


The Jargonaut questions are the result of a cheaper model generating more targeted queries. The baseline approach prompts GPT-3.5 to generate general questions that can be answered by the document, whereas Jargonaut prompts Llama-3.1 8B to generate search queries that should result in the document being returned.
